title: Paysages
identity: Armando Ghidoni's *Paysages* is an Alphonse Leduc saxophone-and-piano work, AL29729, available in E-flat and B-flat editions. The current ABRSM Woodwind syllabus lists it at Grade 7, item 5, with the printed cadenza; the notation's E-flat/B-flat edition designation does not by itself settle the exact saxophone instrument. The score was not inspected.

Leduc catalog corroborates instrumentation and number.
